title: Fuel Quality Lab
objectives: List qualities of an ideal fuel

stages.title: Choosing the Best Fuel
stages.narration: The Guardian Flame needs the finest fuel. Judge fuels by their qualities to reforge ember 6!

steps.text: Rows of fuels await your judgement.
Professor Blaze: 'Which is the ideal fuel?'
Spark Bot loads the calorific value charts.

stages.title: Qualities of an Ideal Fuel
stages.prompt: Tap every quality that a GOOD fuel should have.

feedback.correct: Yes! A good fuel has this quality.
feedback.incorrect: That's a DRAWBACK, not a quality of a good fuel.

stages.title: Higher or Lower Calorific Value?
stages.prompt: More energy per kg = higher calorific value. Compare each pair.

tasks.label: LPG vs Wood
tasks.explain: LPG has a much higher calorific value than wood.

tasks.label: Coal vs Cow-dung cake
tasks.explain: Coal beats dung cake in energy per kg.

tasks.label: Wood vs Hydrogen
tasks.explain: Hydrogen has the highest calorific value of all.

questions.q: Calorific value is the heat from burning…
questions.explain: It's the heat per kilogram of fuel.

questions.q: Which fuel has the highest calorific value?
questions.explain: Hydrogen is the highest, and clean.
Good fuels are cheap, clean and safe.

questions.q: A good fuel's ignition temperature should be…
questions.explain: Too low is dangerous to store.

stages.title: Guardian Flame: Ember 6 Lit!
messages: 🏅 You earned the Fuel Judge badge
You chose the perfect fuel to feed the flame!
